sources.title: ReAlign: Structured Revision for Small Language Model Alignment
sources.snippet: Aligning small language models with human preferences is challenging, as weak policies struggle to generate informative on-policy samples and suffer from unstable gradients when trained on off-policy signals from stronger models.
